IEC 60364-5-52 Cables: Cu XLPE 90°C, Method E perforated tray, k_derate=0.88 (35°C amb × grouping).
*TX1+TX2 paralleling prevented by IL_BUS_TIE (2-of-3); all LV breakers satisfy Icu >= Ik'' & Ib <= In <= Iz.
• N-1 TX1 Out: Q_TX1=OPEN, Q_TX2=CLOSED, Q_BT=CLOSED
• N-1 TX2 Out: Q_TX1=CLOSED, Q_TX2=OPEN, Q_BT=CLOSED
• FORBIDDEN: Q_TX1 + Q_TX2 + Q_BT all CLOSED (Blocked)

• Normal Utility: Q_NORM=CLOSED, Q_GEN=OPEN (EMSB via MSB_B)
